behavior: Offline system-backup-source-materials CLI calls concrete authenticated installer PrepareSourceMaterialIssue. Actual local administrator/bcrypt, exact SQL account/server/database/time, Kubernetes principal/namespace/enrollment/update SSAR and unchanged current owner head CAS are required. No capture_certificate owner record is reinterpreted as a Redis/S3 permission.

Actual Kubernetes reads bind original controller Deployment UID/service account and worker/source API ServiceAccount UIDs. SourceMaterialIssuer is private, not JSON serializable, domain specific and rechecks original definition/current owner state/window/actors before and after signing.

One original complete six-domain functional_test declaration only. Redis purpose must already be functional_test before worker scopes/signatures and controller metadata scope/signature. Issuer must equal original independently enrolled public key. Original NotBefore/Until is preserved and bounded by original Forward/current authority windows; no refresh or multi-purpose selection.

Worker source scopes use the existing exact wire encoding and finite Redis/provider-root declarations. No fabricated skill inventory hash, task authority, ready boolean or passed DTO is used. A pure test compares both hashes to the actual worker scope function using explicit constructor input fixtures.

Builder reads pinned original core/Forward/profile/config, private source credentials and pinned TLS CAs, validates all operation mounts/control evidence/full plan, and loads original publisher-verifier inputs when required. Existing production validators/loadProductionCapture are retained unchanged.

Four distinct outputs must share one existing private absolute directory: two worker grants, metadata grant and complete canonical material bundle. Files are create-only 0600; exact byte-identical retries may reuse files, different/pre-existing/partial files are never overwritten or deleted. Every written file is independently read back; original config/Forward/publisher inputs and authenticated issuer are rechecked before the public hash/window receipt.

Errors can leave original partial files and are not success receipts. There is no config enabling, task creation, readiness publication, provider/role mutation, implicit enrollment or actual source completeness/permission claim.

Bash delivery source verifies independently selected SHA256SUMS hash, exact four-name allowlist, every checksum and exact SOURCE_COMMIT before dispatching only the selected owner-enroll, owner-authority or source-materials binary. It does not build/download/install/activate anything itself.
